title: PACAREG: a Multicenter Registry Trial in Pancreatic Ductal Adencarcinoma
official: PaCaReg: A Multicenter Registry Trial for the Assessement of Clinical, Epidemiological and Biological Profiles in Patients With Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
summary: PaCaReg is a multicenter registry trial aiming in the assessement of clinical, epidemiological and biological profiles in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Treatment naive histologically or cytologically proven pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) or highly suspicious diagnosis (only pre-curative-intended resection)
* Age =\>18 years
* written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* papillary cancer
* neuroendocrine pancreatic tumors
